findings.text: The Inbox itself, the thing that was rebuilt (ask 2), was never shot: the shots are /framework/ux/ and /framework/ux/Browse/, two doc pages. The rail width (a third at 1920, wider at 3440), Waiting on you at the top, and the 400 phone screen are unproven by any picture (requirements ask 2: "Shot after every step… check_page at 400 / 1200 / 1920 / 3440").

The class architecture, the deliverable the owner sees first (ask 1), is cut off: the comment column of "The classes" code block is clipped mid-word at every width — shots/…-ux-Browse/1920.png, band 3 ("THE ORCHESTRATOR. The s…", "every o…"); at 400 only the class names show (400.png, bottom). Wrap the comments or use a list/table.

Browse's page tells and doesn't show (page 1, "show, don't tell"): it is two markdown files and a link; no live Browse or instance view. Its readme even promises "the class architecture, then the demo", and there is no demo — readme.md line 3 vs page.js.

Waiting on you holds 114 lines today (Inbox doc/next.md), mostly "decided N things for you" cards; with a 45vh scroll box it meets "one line each" but not "every open owner decision" as a short, readable list. The upstream fix (one line per task, not a card) is recorded as open.
Every shot logged a console 404 (layout.json `errors`, all four widths, both pages); name the missing resource before landing.

The Browse page wastes the screen at large widths: empty 0.70 at 1920 and 0.81 at 3440, last band `big_empty` true at 3440 (layout.json) — a single prose track for a page whose subject is a wide two-pane view.
Step 3 (Sessions) correctly deferred with a next brief in ai/sessions/doc/next.md; card report and merge are not in the diff, so not checked here.

assign.title: Inbox: one list-and-detail view, waiting-on-you at the top
assign.outcome:
**The Inbox runs on one list-and-detail view, [Browse](/framework/ux/Browse/), and pins Waiting on you at the top.**

- ✅ The class architecture: [Architecture tab](/framework/ux/Browse/architecture/). `Browse` is the orchestrator, `Inbox.Rail extends Browse`, `AIRail extends Inbox.Rail`, and `WaitingOnYou extends Browse.Pinned`.
- ✅ [The Inbox](/framework/ai/) is a Browse. Its list is a third of the screen at 1920 and wider at 3440, where each row reads like a table row. The list is resizable, and on a phone it opens on the list.
- ✅ **Waiting on you** shows every open owner decision (114 today), one line each with its card linked. Tick one and its card is archived; 'tick all' clears the list.
- ⬜ Sessions on Browse: its brief is in [ai/sessions/doc/next.md](/framework/ai/sessions/doc/next.md). The Inbox timeline and a simpler filter row come next: [Inbox doc/next.md](/framework/core/Page/ext/Inbox/doc/next.md).

The class architecture and the build shipped together. Showing the architecture first would have meant a merge with nothing to try. A fresh review found 7 things and 4 were fixed, including a live demo on the Browse page.
